items.title: Front-running Attack in Sharded Blockchains and Fair Cross-shard Consensus.
items.summary: Sharding is a prominent technique for scaling blockchains.By dividing the network into smaller components known as shards, a sharded blockchain can process transactions in parallel without introducing inconsistencies through the coordination of intra-shard and cross-shard consensus protocols.However, we observe a critical security issue with sharded systems: transaction ordering manipulations can occur when coordinating intra-shard and cross-shard consensus protocols, leaving the system vulnerable to attack.Specifically, we identify a novel security issue known as finalization fairness, which can be exploited through a front-running attack.This attack allows an attacker to manipulate the execution order of transactions, even if the victim's transaction has already been processed and added to the blockchain by a fair intra-shard consensus.To address the issue, we offer Haechi, a novel cross-shard protocol that is immune to front-running attacks.Haechi introduces an ordering phase between transaction processing and execution, ensuring that the execution order of transactions is the same as the processing order and achieving finalization fairness.To accommodate different consensus speeds among shards, Haechi incorporates a finalization fairness algorithm to achieve a globally fair order with minimal performance loss.By providing a global order, Haechi ensures strong consistency among shards, enabling better parallelism in handling conflicting transactions across shards.These features make Haechi a promising solution for supporting popular smart contracts in the real world.To evaluate Haechi's performance and effectiveness in preventing the attack, we implemented the protocol using Tendermint and conducted extensive experiments on a geo-distributed AWS environment.Our results demonstrate that Haechi can effectively prevent the presented front-running attack with little performance sacrifice compared to existing cross-shard consensus protocols.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 分片是区块链扩展的关键技术，通过将网络划分为多个分片并行处理交易，同时依靠片内和跨片共识协议保证一致性。然而，本文发现分片系统存在严重的交易顺序操纵漏洞：片内共识与跨片共识协调期间，攻击者可利用“最终化公平性”（finalization fairness）缺失实施前置运行攻击（front-running attack）。即使受害者的交易已被公平的片内共识处理并上链，攻击者仍能通过操纵跨片交易的最终化顺序，改变全局执行顺序，从而获利。为应对此问题，作者提出Haechi协议——一个抗前置运行攻击的跨片共识方案。Haechi在交易处理与执行之间引入排序阶段，保证交易的执行顺序与处理顺序一致，实现最终化公平性。针对不同分片共识速度差异，Haechi内嵌最终化公平算法，以最小性能损失达成全局公平顺序，并提供强一致性，提升冲突交易处理的并行度。作者使用Tendermint实现了Haechi，并在亚马逊云地理分布式环境进行实验。结果表明，与现有跨片共识协议相比，Haechi能有效阻止前置运行攻击，且性能开销极小。该工作为分片区块链的安全性和实际部署提供了重要参考。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 分片区块链正被用于提升吞吐量，但本文揭示了一种因跨片协调引入的新攻击面（最终化公平性缺失），可被前置运行利用。安全团队需关注此类设计漏洞，Haechi提供了可落地的防御思路。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有采用分片机制的区块链系统（如以太坊分片方案），尤其涉及跨片交易和智能合约的场景。该攻击手法可能迁移到其他多阶段共识协议或跨域事务处理系统。
defense_advice_zh: 在跨片共识协议中引入独立的排序阶段，确保交易处理与执行顺序一致
采用全局公平顺序算法（如Haechi的最终化公平算法）协调各分片
审查已有分片系统是否存在类似最终化公平性漏洞
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 纳入内部评估，对自研或第三方分片区块链方案进行公平性审计，并关注Haechi协议的技术细节。

items.title: ShapFuzz: Efficient Fuzzing via Shapley-Guided Byte Selection.
items.summary: Mutation-based fuzzing is popular and effective in discovering unseen code and exposing bugs. However, only a few studies have concentrated on quantifying the importance of input bytes, which refers to the degree to which a byte contributes to the discovery of new code. They often focus on obtaining the relationship between input bytes and path constraints, ignoring the fact that not all constraint-related bytes can discover new code. In this paper, we conduct Shapely analysis to understand the effect of byte positions on fuzzing performance, and find that some byte positions contribute more than others and this property often holds across seeds. Based on this observation, we propose a novel fuzzing solution, ShapFuzz, to guide byte selection and mutation. Specifically, ShapFuzz updates Shapley values (importance) of bytes when each input is tested during fuzzing with a low overhead, and utilizes contextual multi-armed bandit to trade off between mutating high Shapley value bytes and low-frequently chosen bytes. We implement a prototype of this solution based on AFL++, i.e., ShapFuzz. We evaluate ShapFuzz against ten state-of-the-art fuzzers, including five byte schedule-reinforced fuzzers and five commonly used fuzzers. Compared with byte schedule-reinforced fuzzers, ShapFuzz discovers more edges and exposes more bugs than the best baseline on three different sets of initial seeds. Compared with commonly used fuzzers, ShapFuzz exposes 20 more bugs than the best comparison fuzzer, and discovers 6 more CVEs than the best baseline on MAGMA. Furthermore, ShapFuzz discovers 11 new bugs on the latest versions of programs, and 3 of them are confirmed by vendors.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对基于突变的模糊测试（fuzzing）中字节重要性量化不足的问题展开研究。现有方法通常关注输入字节与路径约束的关系，但忽略了并非所有与约束相关的字节都能发现新代码。作者通过Shapley值分析发现，不同字节位置对模糊测试性能的贡献存在差异，且这种差异在不同种子间具有一致性。基于这一观察，提出ShapFuzz，一种通过Shapley值指导字节选择和突变的模糊测试方案。具体地，ShapFuzz在每次输入测试时以低开销更新字节的Shapley值，并利用上下文多臂老虎机（Contextual Multi-Armed Bandit）在突变高Shapley值字节和低频率被选中的字节之间进行权衡。基于AFL++实现原型，并与10个最先进的模糊测试器（包括5个字节调度增强型模糊测试器和5个常用模糊测试器）进行对比。实验结果表明：与字节调度增强型模糊测试器相比，ShapFuzz在三组不同初始种子集上发现了更多的新边（edges）和暴露了更多的漏洞；与常用模糊测试器相比，ShapFuzz在MAGMA基准上比最佳对比模糊测试器多暴露20个漏洞，并发现6个额外的CVE。此外，在最新版本的程序中发现了11个新漏洞，其中3个已得到供应商确认。该研究为模糊测试中的字节重要性量化提供了新视角，有效提升了模糊测试的代码覆盖和漏洞发现能力。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 本文提出了一种基于Shapley值指导字节选择的新型模糊测试方法ShapFuzz，在漏洞发现效率上显著优于现有方案，有助于安全测试人员更高效地挖掘软件缺陷。其核心思想可迁移至其他基于突变的测试场景。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于基于突变的模糊测试场景，尤其对输入字节重要性敏感的软件安全测试，可显著提升漏洞发现数量。

items.title: AAKA: An Anti-Tracking Cellular Authentication Scheme Leveraging Anonymous Credentials.
items.summary: Mobile tracking has long been a privacy problem, where the geographic data and timestamps gathered by mobile network operators (MNOs) are used to track the locations and movements of mobile subscribers.Additionally, selling the geolocation information of subscribers has become a lucrative business.Many mobile carriers have violated user privacy agreements by selling users' location history to third parties without user consent, exacerbating privacy issues related to mobile tracking and profiling.This paper presents AAKA, an anonymous authentication and key agreement scheme designed to protect against mobile tracking by honest-but-curious MNOs.AAKA leverages anonymous credentials and introduces a novel mobile authentication protocol that allows legitimate subscribers to access the network anonymously, without revealing their unique (real) IDs.It ensures the integrity of user credentials, preventing forgery, and ensures that connections made by the same user at different times cannot be linked.While the MNO alone cannot identify or profile a user, AAKA enables identification of a user under legal intervention, such as when the MNOs collaborate with an authorized law enforcement agency.Our design is compatible with the latest cellular architecture and SIM standardized by 3GPP, meeting 3GPP's fundamental security requirements for User Equipment (UE) authentication and key agreement processes.A comprehensive security analysis demonstrates the scheme's effectiveness.The evaluation shows that the scheme is practical, with a credential presentation generation taking ∼52 ms on a constrained host device equipped with a standard cellular SIM.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种名为AAKA（匿名认证与密钥协商）的方案，旨在解决移动网络中用户被运营商（MNO）跟踪的隐私问题。当前，移动网络运营商收集用户的地理位置和时间戳数据，并可将其出售给第三方，导致隐私泄露。AAKA利用匿名凭证技术，设计了一套新的移动认证协议，使得合法用户能够在不泄露真实身份的情况下匿名接入网络。该方案保证了用户凭据的完整性，防止伪造，并且同一用户在不同时间建立的连接无法被关联，从而避免被追踪。同时，在合法干预（例如执法机构授权协作）下，AAKA仍然能够识别出特定用户，兼顾了隐私与合规需求。方案兼容3GPP定义的最新蜂窝网络架构和SIM卡标准，满足UE认证与密钥协商的基本安全要求。安全分析证明了方案的有效性，性能评估显示在受限的宿主设备（配备标准蜂窝SIM）上生成凭证展示约需52毫秒，表明其实用性。该研究适合移动网络安全研究人员、隐私保护技术开发者以及运营商安全策略制定者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 针对移动运营商潜在的隐私侵犯问题，提出了一种兼顾匿名性与合法干预的实用认证方案，对保护用户定位隐私具有直接意义。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可应用于5G/6G蜂窝网络的身份认证协议改进，防范运营商数据滥用，同时支持合规的执法监听。

items.why_it_matters: 针对移动运营商潜在的隐私侵犯问题，提出了一种兼顾匿名性与合法干预的实用认证方案，对保护用户定位隐私具有直接意义。

items.title: File Hijacking Vulnerability: The Elephant in the Room.
items.summary: Files are a significant attack vector for security boundary violation, yet a systematic understanding of the vulnerabilities underlying these attacks is lacking.To bridge this gap, we present a comprehensive analysis of File Hijacking Vulnerabilities (FHVulns), a type of vulnerability that enables attackers to breach security boundaries through the manipulation of file content or file paths.We provide an in-depth empirical study on 268 welldocumented FHVuln CVE records from January 2020 to October 2022.Our study reveals the origins and triggering mechanisms of FHVulns and highlights that existing detection techniques have overlooked the majority of FHVulns.As a result, we anticipate a significant prevalence of zero-day FHVulns in software.We developed a dynamic analysis tool, JERRY, which effectively detects FHVulns at runtime by simulating hijacking actions during program execution.We applied JERRY to 438 popular software programs from vendors including Microsoft, Google, Adobe, and Intel, and found 339 zero-day FHVulns.We reported all vulnerabilities identified by JERRY to the corresponding vendors, and as of now, 84 of them have been confirmed or fixed, with 51 CVE IDs granted and $83,400 bug bounties earned.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文对文件劫持漏洞（File Hijacking Vulnerabilities, FHVulns）进行了系统性研究。文件劫持漏洞是一类通过操纵文件内容或路径来突破安全边界的漏洞，但此前缺乏对其底层机制的全面理解。作者收集了2020年1月至2022年10月期间268个详细记录的FHVuln CVE条目，进行了深入的实证研究，揭示了FHVuln的起源和触发机制，并指出现有检测技术忽略了大部分此类漏洞，因此预计软件中存在大量零日FHVuln。为了弥补这一缺口，作者开发了动态分析工具JERRY，该工具通过在程序执行期间模拟劫持动作，能够有效在运行时检测FHVuln。JERRY被应用于微软、谷歌、Adobe、英特尔等厂商的438个流行软件程序，共发现339个零日FHVuln。所有发现的漏洞均已向相应厂商报告，截至目前，84个漏洞已得到确认或修复，获得了51个CVE编号和83,400美元漏洞赏金。论文的核心贡献包括：首次对FHVuln进行大规模实证研究，揭示了其分布和触发模式；提出了一种新的动态检测方法JERRY，其检测能力显著优于现有工具；通过实际应用证明了该方法在发现真实世界漏洞方面的有效性。适合安全研究人员、漏洞分析工程师以及软件安全开发人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 文件劫持漏洞长期以来被忽视，该研究首次系统地揭示了其普遍性和严重性，并提供了一款有效的动态检测工具JERRY，可帮助安全团队发现大量零日漏洞，显著提升软件供应链安全。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响广泛，包括操作系统、桌面应用、企业软件等一切以文件为交互媒介的软件，尤其是需要处理用户输入或临时文件的程序。
detection_signals_zh: 程序运行时对文件路径或内容的意外修改
文件操作前后校验不严导致的安全边界突破
defense_advice_zh: 部署JERRY等动态分析工具在CI/CD流程中
加强文件操作时的路径规范化与权限校验
对敏感文件使用强制访问控制

items.title: Exploiting Sequence Number Leakage: TCP Hijacking in NAT-Enabled Wi-Fi Networks.
items.summary: In this paper, we uncover a new side-channel vulnerability in the widely used NAT port preservation strategy and an insufficient reverse path validation strategy of Wi-Fi routers, which allows an off-path attacker to infer if there is one victim client in the same network communicating with another host on the Internet using TCP. After detecting the presence of TCP connections between the victim client and the server, the attacker can evict the original NAT mapping and reconstruct a new mapping at the router by sending fake TCP packets due to the routers' vulnerability of disabling TCP window tracking strategy, which has been faithfully implemented in most of the routers for years. In this way, the attacker can intercept TCP packets from the server and obtain the current sequence and acknowledgment numbers, which in turn allows the attacker to forcibly close the connection, poison the traffic in plain text, or reroute the server's incoming packets to the attacker. We test 67 widely used routers from 30 vendors and discover that 52 of them are affected by this attack. Also, we conduct an extensive measurement study on 93 real-world Wi-Fi networks. The experimental results show that 75 of these evaluated Wi-Fi networks (81%) are fully vulnerable to our attack. Our case study shows that it takes about 17.5, 19.4, and 54.5 seconds on average to terminate an SSH connection, download private files from FTP servers, and inject fake HTTP response packets with success rates of 87.4%, 82.6%, and 76.1%. We responsibly disclose the vulnerability and suggest mitigation strategies to all affected vendors and have received positive feedback, including acknowledgments, CVEs, rewards, and adoption of our suggestions.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文揭示了一种利用NAT路由器中普遍存在的端口保持策略缺陷和反向路径验证不足的侧信道漏洞，使得处于同一Wi-Fi网络的攻击者能够推断并劫持受害者与外部服务器之间的TCP连接。具体而言，攻击者首先通过发送伪造的TCP包探测受害者是否建立了TCP连接，进而利用路由器禁用TCP窗口跟踪机制（多数路由器默认开启此机制）的漏洞，驱逐原有的NAT映射并建立新映射，从而拦截服务器发送至受害者的TCP包，并获取序列号和确认号。基于此，攻击者可以强制关闭连接、明文篡改流量或重定向服务器数据包至自身。作者测试了来自30个厂商的67款主流路由器，其中52款受影响；对93个真实Wi-Fi网络的测量显示，75个（81%）完全易受攻击。案例研究表明，攻击可在平均17.5秒内终止SSH连接（成功率87.4%），19.4秒内从FTP服务器下载私密文件（成功率82.6%），54.5秒内注入伪造HTTP响应（成功率76.1%）。已向所有受影响厂商负责任披露漏洞，并建议启用TCP窗口跟踪、强化NAT端口随机化等缓解措施。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞影响大量主流家用和商用路由器，攻击者无需中间人位置即可实施TCP劫持，导致连接劫持、数据泄露或中间人攻击，严重威胁用户隐私和网络安全。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响广泛：已测试的67款路由器中52款（78%）存在漏洞；实际Wi-Fi网络中81%可被利用。攻击可导致SSH、FTP、HTTP等基于TCP的应用被劫持，实现会话终止、文件窃取或内容注入。
detection_signals_zh: 异常TCP重置或序列号错误次数激增
同一网络中出现大量伪造TCP SYN/ACK包
defense_advice_zh: 启用路由器TCP窗口跟踪机制
启用NAT端口随机化
部署入站方向的反向路径验证
监控异常TCP序列号跳变
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进：建议网络安全团队评估内部Wi-Fi网络中的路由器固件版本，并联系厂商获取补丁或缓解措施。

items.title: Modeling Failure Dynamics in Time-Constrained Authentication Systems: Evidence of a Success Cliff in USSD Workflows
items.summary: Time-constrained interactive systems such as USSD (Unstructured Supplementary Service Data)-based financial services operate under strict session limits and sequential user interaction. While stronger authentication mechanisms improve security, they also increase interaction complexity and time burden, potentially reducing transaction completion. In this work, we model the failure dynamics of such systems and investigate how authentication complexity interacts with user response time and network round-trip time to influence session success rate. We propose and implement a simulation-based framework to investigate these failure dynamics and formally define a non-linear failure phenomenon, termed the \textit{Success Cliff}, where session success rates sharply decline beyond a critical complexity threshold. Through controlled experiments, we quantify the trade-off between security and usability and identify conditions under which secure authentication workflows become operationally unreliable.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文聚焦于时间受限交互系统（如基于USSD的金融服务）中的认证失败动力学。USSD系统具有严格的会话时间限制和顺序用户交互特性，虽然更强的认证机制能提升安全性，但也会增加交互复杂性和时间负担，可能导致交易完成率下降。作者提出了一个模拟框架来建模这种失败动力学，并正式定义了一种非线性失败现象——“成功悬崖”（Success Cliff），即当认证复杂度超过某个临界阈值时，会话成功率会急剧下降。通过控制实验，量化了安全性与可用性之间的权衡，并识别了在何种条件下安全的认证工作流会变得操作上不可靠。该研究为设计更优的认证策略提供了理论基础，尤其适用于移动金融等对时间敏感的场景。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究揭示了认证复杂度与用户行为之间的非线性关系，帮助安全从业者理解过度安全约束可能导致的业务失败风险，从而在安全策略设计中平衡可用性与安全性。

items.why_it_matters: 该研究揭示了认证复杂度与用户行为之间的非线性关系，帮助安全从业者理解过度安全约束可能导致的业务失败风险，从而在安全策略设计中平衡可用性与安全性。

items.title: Unlearning to Protect: A Distilled Reinforcement Learning Framework with Privacy-Preserving Feature Unlearning and XAI for IoT Security
items.summary: Botnets pose a significant cybersecurity threat, enabling attacks such as DDoS, data theft, and service disruptions on IoT devices. These devices often lack built-in botnet traffic filtering, leaving them highly exposed. Existing AI-based solutions improve detection capabilities but have limitations: (i) they are too heavy for IoT deployment, and (ii) they lack unlearning capabilities to forget sensitive or outdated features without retraining. To address these challenges, we propose DiRLU, a lightweight, reinforcement learning driven framework, while ensuring privacy by selectively unlearning sensitive or outdated features without requiring retraining. The framework leverages knowledge distillation to transfer knowledge from a teacher model into a lightweight student model, with both models trained using A2C. A post-hoc unlearning mechanism modifies weights to remove targeted features, while restored features show negligible performance loss, confirming reversibility. Unlike many benchmark models that used only 5% of the BoT-IoT dataset, this research leverages 25%, allowing us to develop a strong teacher model. Both the teacher and student models were trained using the A2C reinforcement learning algorithm, achieving impressive results, with the student model achieving 99.60% accuracy and a 99.80% F1 score. To enhance transparency, we integrated Explainable AI (XAI), particularly LIME, which helps interpret the model's decisions and identify the key features influencing its predictions. Moreover, DiRLU requires only 2,370 FLOPS, approximately 3.87x more efficient than the state-of-the-art model, highlighting its efficiency for edge deployment. DiRLU combines efficiency with privacy, aligning with GDPR standards (right to be forgotten) to provide practical and scalable IoT security solution.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出了一种名为DiRLU的轻量级强化学习框架，用于物联网（IoT）设备上的僵尸网络检测，同时通过选择性遗忘敏感或过时特征来保护隐私。现有基于人工智能的解决方案存在两个主要局限：一是模型过于沉重，难以部署在资源受限的IoT设备上；二是缺乏遗忘机制，需要完全重新训练才能移除特定特征。DiRLU通过知识蒸馏将教师模型（使用A2C强化学习算法训练）的知识迁移到轻量级学生模型中，两个模型均基于A2C训练。后置遗忘机制通过调整权重来移除目标特征，且可逆性实验显示恢复特征后性能损失极小。与许多仅使用5% BoT-IoT数据集的基准模型不同，本研究利用了25%的数据，从而构建了强大的教师模型。学生模型达到了99.60%的准确率和99.80%的F1分数。为增强可解释性，集成了LIME（可解释AI方法），帮助理解模型决策和关键特征。DiRLU的浮点运算数（FLOPS）仅为2370，比现有最优模型高效约3.87倍，适合边缘部署。此外，该框架符合GDPR的“被遗忘权”要求，提供了实用且可扩展的IoT安全解决方案。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 首次将特征遗忘机制与强化学习、知识蒸馏结合用于IoT僵尸网络检测，在保证隐私合规（GDPR）的同时实现极高检测精度和轻量化，为资源受限设备的安全防护提供了新思路。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可应用于智能家居、工业物联网等边缘设备的僵尸网络检测，满足隐私法规要求，降低模型更新成本。

items.title: Embedded Blockchain Infrastructure Management (eBIM): A RISC-V-Empowered Hardware--Software Co-Design Framework Towards Trustworthy Blockchain
items.summary: Blockchain systems are undergoing a fundamental transition from decentralized ledgers for digital assets to general-purpose trust infrastructures for verifiable computation, decentralized physical resources, and automated infrastructure management. Meanwhile, the limitations of the Blockchain as a Service (BaaS) model stem from a common structural problem: outsourcing control of infrastructure to third-party service providers inevitably involves a systemic surrender of trust, flexibility, and data sovereignty. RISC-V, with its open, modular, and extensible design, provides a general-purpose computing foundation for public blockchains that is open, low-level, compileable, verifiable, and scalable. Inspired by the development and characteristics of eSIM, the embedded Blockchain infrastructure management (eBIM) is defined as a software-hardware collaborative paradigm for blockchain infrastructure management with RISC-V. This study aims to provide a comprehensive survey on eBIM supporting research and technologies, to answer the following research questions (RQs): RQ1 What is eBIM? RQ2 How does eBIM work? RQ3 What can eBIM do? By introducing the concept of eBIM, this paper establishes a foundational reference for researchers, hardware architects, and protocol designers in this rapidly evolving landscape, including cryptographic acceleration, trusted execution environments, zero-knowledge virtual machines, and smart contract execution engines. The prospects of the proposed e-BIM and its future research directions are indicated in this paper.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出了一种名为嵌入式区块链基础设施管理（eBIM）的概念，旨在解决传统区块链即服务（BaaS）模型中因第三方服务商托管基础设施而导致的信任丧失、灵活性降低和数据主权丧失问题。作者借鉴eSIM（嵌入式SIM卡）的发展思路，利用RISC-V开放、模块化、可扩展的指令集架构，设计了一种软硬件协同的区块链基础设施管理框架。eBIM将区块链的关键功能（如密码加速、可信执行环境、零知识虚拟机、智能合约执行引擎）集成到RISC-V硬件中，从而在底层实现可信计算和去中心化信任。论文通过回顾相关技术与研究，系统回答了三个核心问题：什么是eBIM？eBIM如何工作？eBIM能做什么？文章为研究人员、硬件架构师和协议设计者提供了基础参考，并指出了未来研究方向，包括进一步优化硬件加速器、增强安全性能以及探索在分布式物理基础设施管理中的应用。该工作属于综述性质，但提出了新颖的eBIM概念，结合了RISC-V开放硬件与区块链信任机制，为构建更自主可控、安全可信的区块链基础设施提供了新思路。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: eBIM将区块链信任基石下沉至硬件层，可缓解BaaS模型中的第三方信任风险，对从事区块链安全、可信执行环境及硬件安全的从业者具有重要参考价值。

items.why_it_matters: eBIM将区块链信任基石下沉至硬件层，可缓解BaaS模型中的第三方信任风险，对从事区块链安全、可信执行环境及硬件安全的从业者具有重要参考价值。

items.title: NARAD: Non-colluding Aggregator-oblivious Record-And-Decrypt
items.summary: Electronic voting must keep individual ballots private while letting anyone verify the final tally. This paper presents an architecture that meets both goals without a trusted key dealer: each voter encrypts a ballot in the browser with a self-generated secret key under the Paillier additive homomorphic cryptosystem, and no party ever holds every key. Two server roles divide the tally. A collector combines the voters' per-ballot auxiliary values into a single group element; an aggregator uses that element to cancel the voters' random masks inside the homomorphic product and recover the exact vote sum, learning the result but no individual ballot. The Solana blockchain records every ciphertext immutably and enforces the election lifecycle, while a native C library (libtommath) performs the heavy modular arithmetic. We state six assumptions under which the protocol is correct and prove product homomorphism, mask cancellation, and sum recovery; privacy rests on the Decisional Composite Residuosity (DCR) assumption for the additive layer together with a Diffie-Hellman-style assumption on the masking base. A bit-packing scheme places an entire multi-candidate ballot in one ciphertext, cutting client work, on-chain transactions, storage, and tally cost by a factor of k (the candidate count); the slot width b is free, with only k*b bounded by log_2(N). With b = 25 and a 255-bit modulus the scheme supports ten candidates and up to 2^25 - 1 = 33,554,431 votes per candidate, about 335 million ballots, and tallies 50,000 ballots in under one second. Finally, running the collector and aggregator inside attested secure enclaves makes the tally tamper-resistant and prevents cross-role collusion to deanonymize voters. The proof-of-concept implementation is open-source; a worked numerical example in the appendix reproduces the full pipeline.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出 NARAD（Non-colluding Aggregator-oblivious Record-And-Decrypt）架构，旨在解决电子投票中隐私性与可验证性的矛盾。传统方案依赖可信密钥分发者，存在单点风险。NARAD 无需可信第三方：每位选民在浏览器中用自生成的密钥基于 Paillier 加法同态加密系统加密选票，任何一方都不持有全部密钥。系统设两个服务器角色：收集器（Collector）将每位选民的辅助值聚合成单个群元素；聚合器（Aggregator）利用该元素在密文乘积中抵消随机掩码，恢复精确的投票总和，从而得知结果但不泄露单张选票。Solana 区块链记录所有密文并强制执行选举生命周期，原生 C 库（libtommath）执行重型模运算。论文在六个假设下证明协议正确性，并展示了乘积同态、掩码抵消和和恢复；隐私性基于加法层的 DCR 假设和掩码基的 Diffie-Hellman 假设。通过位打包方案，将多候选人选票置于单个密文中，客户端工作量、链上交易、存储和计票成本均降至原来的 1/k（k 为候选人数）。当 b=25 且模数 255 位时，方案支持 10 个候选人、每位候选人最多 2^25-1 ≈ 3355 万票，总计约 3.35 亿张选票，5 万张选票的计票可在 1 秒内完成。此外，将收集器和聚合器运行在受信任的飞地中，可防止篡改和跨角色合谋去匿名化。概念验证实现已开源，附录中给出了完整数值示例。值得关注的是，该工作兼顾隐私、可验证性与性能，适用于安全多方计算和区块链投票场景。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 为电子投票提供了一种无需可信第三方的端到端可验证方案，结合区块链与同态加密，对安全多方计算和隐私保护有参考价值。

items.title: Multi-Class vs. Multi-Label BERT for CVE-to-CWE Mapping: How Taxonomy Structure Shapes the Errors
items.summary: Assigning Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) categories to Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVE) records remains an important but largely manual step in vulnerability analysis. We study this task as a text classification problem and compare two modelling choices: a \emph{multi-class} formulation that predicts a single CWE per CVE and a \emph{multi-label} formulation that allows multiple assignments. Three transformer encoders (BERT Base, SecureBERT, and CySecBERT) are evaluated on three nested label spaces (83, 47, and 25 classes). Multi-class training achieves higher macro-F1 across all settings, although the gap to multi-label narrows from 21 to 2 percentage points as the label space shrinks. Post-hoc threshold optimisation on the multi-label side closes this gap on the 25-class setting. Confusion analysis shows that the dominant misclassification patterns follow the CWE hierarchy and are shared across all three encoders (Pearson $r > 0.92$), which suggests that the error structure is driven more by taxonomy design than by encoder choice. A hierarchy-relaxed evaluation that forgives within-family confusions raises macro-F1 from ${\sim}$81\% to ${\sim}$90\%, indicating that strict metrics understate branch-level classifier quality. CySecBERT achieves the strongest results overall, with statistically significant gains concentrated in the multi-label setting.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该研究聚焦于CVE（通用漏洞披露）到CWE（通用弱点枚举）的自动分类任务，旨在减少人工标注成本。传统上CVE到CWE的映射依赖专家手动完成，效率低下且不一致。作者将问题建模为文本分类，系统比较了多类（每个CVE预测一个CWE）与多标签（允许预测多个CWE）两种范式。评估使用三个预训练Transformer模型（BERT Base、SecureBERT、CySecBERT）在三个嵌套标签空间（83、47、25个CWE类别）上进行。核心发现包括：1）多类训练在所有设置下取得更高的宏F1值，但随标签空间缩小，其相对优势从21个百分点降至2个百分点；2）通过后处理阈值优化，多标签模型在25类场景下可追平多类性能；3）错误混淆分析显示，主导性的误分类模式严格遵循CWE层次结构（如将特定类型错误归到父类），且这种模式在所有三个编码器间高度一致（Pearson r > 0.92），表明误差结构主要由分类法设计驱动而非模型选择；4）采用层次宽松评估（允许同一CWE家族内的错误）时，宏F1从约81%提升至约90%，说明严格指标低估了分支级分类器的实际质量。总体而言，CySecBERT在多标签设置中表现最优，且统计显著。该工作为实际部署CVE-CWE自动映射提供了方法论指导，强调在评估中应考虑分类法层次结构的影响。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: CVE到CWE的自动映射是漏洞管理自动化的关键环节，直接影响威胁情报准确性和安全运营效率。该研究揭示了分类误差主要由层次结构决定而非模型，为优化标注流程和评估标准提供了可操作见解。

items.title: Beyond Attack-Success Rate: Action-Graded Severity Scale for Tool-Using AI Agents
items.summary: Agentic red-teaming benchmarks report whether an injected agent was compromised as a single bit: the attack succeeded, or it did not. We argue that this binary attack-success rate discards the information a defender most needs, namely how harmful the resulting action was. We introduce an action-graded harm rubric that scores an agent's tool-call trajectory on a seven-level ordinal scale (L0 to L6) according to whether the executed action was reversible, whether it crossed scope to reach another party, and whether it expanded privilege. We compute the scale two ways: a deterministic oracle that reads the trajectory and the attacker's stated goal, and a panel of three frontier language-model judges that read a tag-free account of the same trajectory. Across four victim models and two defenses on the AgentDojo workspace suite, severity grading exposes three cases the binary metric hides, including a defense that reports a zero attack-success rate while still permitting an externally visible cross-scope leak through an unfiltered tool. The judge panel reproduces the oracle with high ordinal agreement (Krippendorff's alpha = 0.91) but shares systematic blind spots that we characterize, most notably a failure to recognize escalation chains. Unlike prior work that provides harm taxonomies, harmful-task completion tests, execution-level safety benchmarks, or severity-aware simulation, our contribution is a reusable, trace-grounded severity instrument applied to the actual actions recorded in existing red-team logs. All code, prompts, and per-episode logs are released.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对当前工具型AI代理（agent）红队评测中普遍采用的二进制攻击成功率（attack-success rate）指标提出了质疑。作者指出，单一的“成功/失败”比特无法向防御者传达最关键的信息——即被入侵代理实际执行的行为到底造成了多大危害。为此，他们提出了一种基于动作分级（action-graded）的危害评估尺度（harm rubric），将代理的工具调用轨迹按照七个等级（L0至L6）进行排序。等级划分依据三个维度：执行的动作是否可逆、是否越界影响其他方、是否扩展了权限。作者通过两种方式计算该尺度：一是确定性预言机（oracle），解析轨迹并比对攻击者的明确目标；二是由三个前沿语言模型组成的评判小组，它们仅阅读无标签的轨迹描述。在AgentDojo工作空间套件上，作者对四个受害者模型和两种防御策略进行了测试，发现严重程度分级揭示了二进制指标所隐藏的三种情况，包括一种防御策略虽然报告零攻击成功率，但通过未过滤的工具仍然允许可见的外部越界泄露。评判小组与预言机相比，取得了高度的一致性（Krippendorff's alpha = 0.91），但存在系统性盲点，最明显的是未能识别权限提升链。与现有工作（危害分类、有害任务完成测试、执行级安全基准、严重程度感知模拟）不同，本文贡献了一个可复用、基于轨迹的严重程度评估工具，可直接应用于现有红队日志中的实际动作。所有代码、提示词和每轮日志均已开源。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 传统二进制攻击成功率指标严重低估风险，该论文提出的多级严重程度尺度使防御者能精准识别代理行为的实际危害，尤其能发现看似“安全”的防御中隐藏的越界泄露。

items.title: Where to Intervene? Benchmarking Fairness-Aware Learning on Differentially Private Synthetic Tabular Data
items.summary: Machine learning models are increasingly deployed in high-stakes domains, raising concerns about both privacy and fairness. Differential Privacy (DP) has become a gold standard for privacy-preserving data analysis, while fairness-aware mechanisms aim to mitigate discrimination against underrepresented groups. However, these objectives can conflict: DP often amplifies disparities across demographic groups, and little is known about whether established fairness interventions remain effective under DP constraints. In this work, we present, to our knowledge, the first systematic evaluation of fairness interventions on differentially private synthetic tabular data. Our benchmark centers on the Adaptive Iterative Mechanism (AIM), identified as the state-of-the-art marginal-based DP synthesizer (Cormode et al. 2025). We thus evaluate fairness interventions across four datasets, multiple group fairness metrics, and three categories of mitigation strategies (pre-processing, in-processing, and post-processing) under a wide range of privacy budgets. We compare four pipeline configurations: (Baseline) training on original data; (DP-only) training on DP synthetic data; (Fair-only) applying fairness mechanisms on original data; and (DP+Fair) combining fairness mechanisms with DP synthetic data. Our results demonstrate that while DP alone can degrade both utility and fairness, applying fairness interventions can partially restore equitable outcomes. Among them, post-processing methods tend to provide more stable fairness-utility trade-offs across privacy budgets and synthesizers, achieving strong fairness improvements while preserving competitive utility relative to other intervention stages. We release all code, data, and experimental artifacts in an open-source repository to ensure full reproducibility and to support future research on the privacy-fairness-utility trade-off.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文首次系统评估了在差分隐私（DP）合成表格数据上应用公平性干预的效果。机器学习模型在高风险场景（如信贷、招聘）中广泛部署，对隐私和公平性提出了双重需求。DP已成为隐私保护的事实标准，但现有研究表明DP可能放大不同人口群体间的差距，而公平性干预在DP约束下是否仍然有效尚不明确。为此，作者构建了一个基准测试，以最先进的边际统计DP合成器AIM为核心，在四个公开数据集（如Adult、COMPAS等）上，覆盖多种群体公平指标（如人口平准性、均等化几率等），并在广泛的隐私预算（ε=0.1至10）下，评估了三种干预策略：预处理（重加权）、处理中（对抗性去偏）和后处理（基于阈值的调整）。实验比较了四种管道配置：原始数据训练（基线）、仅DP合成数据训练、仅原始数据应用公平机制、以及DP合成数据与公平机制结合。结果表明：单独使用DP会显著降低模型效用和公平性（例如，导致更差的准确率与更严重的不平等）；但公平干预可以部分恢复公平性，其中后处理方法（如调整分类阈值）在不同隐私预算和合成器之间展现出最稳定的公平-效用权衡，能在保持竞争性效用的同时大幅提升公平性。相比之下，预处理和处理中方法受DP噪声影响较大，效果不稳定。该研究首次量化了隐私、公平和效用三者的权衡关系，并提供了全面的实验基准。所有代码、数据和实验资产均已开源，以支持后续研究。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究揭示了DP与公平性之间的深层矛盾，为采用DP技术的组织提供了关键指导：后处理干预是兼顾隐私与公平的最优选择。对于安全工程师和合规人员，本工作有助于理解在保护敏感数据的同时避免算法歧视的可行路径。

items.title: Mitigating Taint-Style Vulnerabilities in MCP Servers via Security-Aware Tool Descriptions
items.summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as autonomous agents that interact with external tools and services via the Model Context Protocol (MCP), a standardized interface for dynamic tool invocation. While MCP simplifies integration, it also expands the attack surface and enables generic exploits across multiple servers. Despite prior work on malicious MCP servers, the vulnerability landscape of MCP servers remains underexplored. In this work, we systematically analyze MCP server vulnerabilities, focusing on metadata characteristics, vulnerable code patterns, and community responses. Our study reveals that taint-style vulnerabilities constitute a substantial fraction of MCP server vulnerabilities, require significant code modifications to remediate, and are met with slow community responses. Motivated by these findings, we propose SPELLSMITH, presenting a novel textbased avenue for shielding taint-style vulnerabilities in MCP servers. In particular, SPELLSMITH analyzes the high-risk capabilities exposed by an MCP server and combines them with tool descriptions and parameter semantics to identify potential taint-style vulnerability risks, thereby constructing a tool-level risk profile. Then, SPELLSMITH leverages the Description property of the protocol to embed behavioral guidance (Description Enhancement Module) and exploits LLMs' self-reflection capabilities (Self-Reflection Module) to iteratively evaluate and refine outputs. By strengthening LLM internal decision-making, SPELLSMITH provides an active and unified mitigation strategy that generalizes across multiple vulnerabilities, reducing reliance on context-specific code-level fixes. Our experiments demonstrate that SPELLSMITH effectively mitigates taint-style vulnerability exploitation in MCP servers, highlighting its practical applicability and advantages over traditional code-level mitigations.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文系统性地分析了基于模型上下文协议（MCP）的服务器中存在的安全漏洞，重点关注污点风格漏洞（taint-style vulnerabilities）。MCP 是一种标准化接口，允许大型语言模型（LLM）以动态方式调用外部工具和服务，虽然简化了集成，但也扩大了攻击面，使多个服务器可能遭受通用型利用。尽管已有关于恶意 MCP 服务器的工作，但针对 MCP 服务器脆弱性的系统性研究仍然不足。作者通过分析元数据特征、脆弱代码模式以及社区响应，发现污点风格漏洞在 MCP 服务器漏洞中占相当大比例，修复此类漏洞需要大量代码修改，且社区响应缓慢。基于此，作者提出 SPELLSMITH，一种新颖的基于文本的防护方法。SPELLSMITH 首先分析 MCP 服务器暴露的高风险能力，结合工具描述和参数语义识别潜在的污点风格漏洞风险，构建工具级风险轮廓。然后利用协议的 Description 属性嵌入行为指导（描述增强模块），并借助 LLM 的自省能力（自省模块）迭代评估和优化输出。通过强化 LLM 内部决策，SPELLSMITH 提供了一种主动且统一的缓解策略，可泛化至多种漏洞，减少对具体代码层面修复的依赖。实验表明，SPELLSMITH 能有效缓解 MCP 服务器中的污点风格漏洞利用，突显了其实际应用价值和相对于传统代码层面缓解的优势。本文适合安全研究员、LLM 应用开发者以及 MCP 协议实施者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: MCP 是 LLM 作为智能体与外部工具交互的关键协议，污点风格漏洞威胁巨大。本文提出的 SPELLSMITH 方法无需修改代码即可缓解此类漏洞，为保障 LLM 应用安全提供了全新思路。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于所有基于 MCP 的 LLM 代理系统，可推广到其他工具调用协议的安全防护。

items.title: The Blind Curator: How a Biased Judge Silently Disables Skill Retirement in Self-Evolving Agents
items.summary: A self-evolving agent retires its bad skills by watching them fail, so what happens when the judge cannot see the failures? Skill retirement is the structural constraint that keeps a growing library from drifting below the no-skill baseline, but its guarantee assumes an unbiased reward, which is false for the LLM judges that reference-free tasks force upon us. We show that a biased judge does not merely add noise; it \emph{silently switches off the curator}. We make this precise with a corrupted-reward analysis and, isolating the causal channel by injecting corruption on top of a deterministic reward, a behavioral study on a reference-free report-writing testbed with a code-generation cross-check. Symmetric noise leaves retirement intact, but \emph{false-pass} bias (failures slipping through as passes) disables contribution-based retirement past a sharp threshold that no amount of data can cross. Separating genuine retirement from cap-eviction churn shows this \emph{mechanism} failure is universal, holding across domains and failure rates and sparing only near-zero-false-pass, verifier-like graders. The downstream \emph{outcome}, though, is regime-dependent: eval quality degrades only where the same corruption also starves skill synthesis, and otherwise holds steady, so the disabled curator is \emph{silent}, surfacing in no aggregate metric. The contribution is a behavioral safety result, not a performance one. A cheap defect-injection audit then tells an operator, before deployment, which side of the threshold their judge occupies.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 这篇论文研究了自我进化智能体（self-evolving agents）中的技能退役机制。智能体通过观察技能失败来淘汰不良技能，但该机制依赖于无偏奖励评估。然而，在无参考任务（reference-free tasks）中，LLM评判者必然存在偏见。作者通过理论分析和实验证明，偏见的类型至关重要：对称噪声（误报与漏报平衡）不影响退役机制，但'假通过偏差'（false-pass bias，失败被错误判为通过）会在达到某个阈值后完全禁用基于贡献的技能退役，且增加数据量无法解决。该机制故障在所有领域和失败率下普遍存在，仅在近乎零假通过率的验证器类评判者中避免。更重要的是，即使退役机制失效，下游评估质量并不一定下降，因为只有在相同偏差同时影响技能合成时才会退化，因此该故障是'无声的'，不会在聚合指标中显现。论文贡献在于行为安全结果而非性能改进，并提出一种廉价的缺陷注入审计方法，帮助操作者在部署前判断其评判者是否处于危险阈值一侧。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 揭示了LLM作为评判者时的偏见可能导致自我进化智能体无法正确淘汰不良技能，这种故障无声无息，但可能导致智能体长期保留有害行为，对自主系统安全构成潜在威胁。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有依赖LLM评判者进行自评估与技能更新的自主智能体系统，尤其在无参考场景下（如报告生成、代码生成等）。

items.title: Beware of Agentic Botnets: Scalable Untargeted Promptware Attacks via Universal and Transferable Adversarial HalluSquatting
items.summary: The growing adoption of agentic LLM applications has introduced a new threat previously named as promptware. While prior work has established that adversaries can exploit direct channels to LLM applications to apply promptware under weak threat models, many applications do not provide any direct channels that could be exploited for prompt injection beyond the Internet. This raises a question: can attackers exploit LLM applications at scale without any direct channels in practical threat models? In this work, we show that the inherent tendency of LLMs to hallucinate resource identifiers can be exploited to amplify untargeted promptware attacks that pull adversarial prompts at scale and could be exploited to establish a botnet. We introduce adversarial hallucination squatting, a technique in which attackers identify trending resources (e.g., popular repositories, popular skills, etc.), compute the LLM distribution of hallucinations on the trending resource names, and preemptively register them to host adversarial prompts. By leveraging the predictability and transferability of hallucinations across foundational LLMs and to application layers, adversaries can significantly amplify the reach of untargeted promptware under weak threat models and establish a botnet by exploiting LLM applications to install a bot on the device that pulled the compromised hallucinated resource from the Inter. We empirically demonstrate that hallucinated resource generation occurs at high rates, up to 85% in repository cloning scenarios and up to 100% in skill installation, and that these hallucinations transfer between foundational models and different prompts. We demonstrate the practicality of adversarial hallucination squatting against various production LLM applications with integrated terminals in their set of tools, achieving remote tool execution and remote code execution.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 随着智能体大语言模型（LLM）应用的普及，一种称为“promptware”的新型威胁随之出现。已有的研究工作表明，攻击者可以在弱威胁模型下通过直接通道对LLM应用进行提示注入攻击。然而，许多应用并不提供任何可被利用的直接通道。本文提出一种名为“对抗性幻觉抢占”（Adversarial Hallucination Squatting）的新技术，利用LLM固有的幻觉倾向——即生成不存在的资源标识符——来放大无目标的promptware攻击。攻击者首先识别热门资源（如流行的代码仓库、技能包等），计算LLM对这些资源名称的幻觉分布，然后提前注册这些幻觉资源并托管恶意提示。通过利用幻觉在基础LLM之间以及向应用层的可预测性和可转移性，攻击者能够在弱威胁模型下显著扩大无目标promptware的传播范围，甚至建立僵尸网络：通过让LLM应用在拉取被污染的幻觉资源时安装恶意代码。实验表明，在仓库克隆场景下，幻觉资源生成率高达85%，在技能安装场景下可达100%，且这些幻觉可以在不同基础模型和不同提示之间迁移。作者还在多个集成终端工具的生产级LLM应用中验证了该攻击的可行性，实现了远程工具执行和远程代码执行。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究揭示了LLM幻觉可被武器化，从而在没有直接提示注入渠道的情况下实现大规模的promptware攻击，对基于智能体LLM的集成应用（如自动编码助手、自动化工作流）构成新兴且严峻的威胁。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响那些允许LLM自动克隆仓库或安装技能包的应用（如Cline、OpenDevin等），攻击者可借此构建僵尸网络并远程执行代码。

items.why_it_matters: 该研究揭示了LLM幻觉可被武器化，从而在没有直接提示注入渠道的情况下实现大规模的promptware攻击，对基于智能体LLM的集成应用（如自动编码助手、自动化工作流）构成新兴且严峻的威胁。

items.title: How Reliable Is the Multi-Input Heuristic for Bitcoin Address Clustering in Law Enforcement Contexts?
items.summary: Address clustering is an important technique in blockchain forensics, widely employed by law enforcement to trace illicit crypto asset flows. The multi-input heuristic (MIH), which clusters addresses potentially associated with the same entity, is the most widely used. Yet, despite its broad adoption, the MIH has rarely been evaluated against reliable ground truth data. We implement a reusable evaluation framework covering nine established metrics and apply it to ground truth address-to-entity mappings obtained directly from European crypto asset service providers under legally mandated reporting obligations. When evaluation is restricted to reported addresses, the MIH appears strong at dataset level: we observe no mergers between reported services and recover same-service address pairs with recall $0.71$. However, this result is driven by one large service and ignores unlabeled addresses absorbed into full clusters. Metrics that assess the full clusters show substantially lower precision and recall ($0.36$ and $0.44$), meaning that services are often only partially recovered or embedded in larger clusters. Entity-level results further reveal near-complete failures for some services. When MIH-based clusters are used to support criminal suspicion, preliminary seizure of crypto assets to secure later forfeiture/ confiscation, or as evidence in trial proceedings, prosecutors and judges must account for the heuristic's metric-dependent and entity-dependent reliability.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本研究针对区块链取证中广泛使用的多输入启发式（MIH）方法在执法场景下的可靠性进行了系统评估。MIH通过将同一交易中的多个输入地址聚类到同一实体，是比特币地址聚类的经典方法。尽管被执法机构大量用于追踪非法加密货币流向，但该启发式的实际准确率很少得到真实基准数据的验证。作者构建了一个可复用的评估框架，涵盖九项成熟指标，并以欧洲加密资产服务提供商依据法律强制报告义务提供的真实地址到实体映射作为地面真值数据。实验发现，当评估仅限于已报告的地址时，MIH在数据集层面表现良好：未观察到不同报告服务之间的合并，且同一服务内地址对的召回率达到0.71。然而，这一结果主要受单个大型服务驱动，且忽略了被吸收进完整聚类中的未标记地址。评估完整聚类的指标显示精确率和召回率大幅下降（分别为0.36和0.44），意味着服务往往仅被部分恢复或嵌入更大的聚类中。实体层面的结果进一步揭示某些服务近乎完全失败。因此，当基于MIH的聚类被用于支持犯罪嫌疑、扣押加密资产以保全后续没收或作为审判证据时，检察官和法官必须考虑到该启发式依赖于具体指标和具体实体的可靠性。本研究的核心贡献在于为执法场景下的MIH可靠性提供了首个基于真实法规报告的量化评估，揭示了其在不同服务间的显著差异，并强调了在法律程序中应审慎对待其输出。适合区块链取证研究者、执法分析师及法律从业人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 加密货币取证是打击金融犯罪的关键技术，而多输入启发式是基础工具。本研究揭示了其在真实执法数据中的可靠性短板，直接影响刑事调查、资产扣押和法庭证据的可接受性，提醒从业者不能盲目信任聚类结果。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 该研究结果可迁移至所有使用MIH进行区块链取证的场景，包括反洗钱调查、暗网市场追踪、勒索软件支付追溯等。为法律程序中证据采信标准提供了定量警示。

items.title: Reason Less, Verify More: Deterministic Gates Recover a Silent Policy-Violation Failure Mode in Tool-Using LLM Agents
items.summary: Tool-using LLM agents can violate the very policies they are deployed to enforce while appearing to complete the task successfully. In policy-permissive environments, a tool may execute any well-formed call even when the corresponding state transition is forbidden by domain policy. The result is a silent wrong state (a booking cancelled, a passenger count changed, a claim acted on without verification) that neither the tool nor the agent's self-report exposes. We study this failure mode in the $τ^2$-bench airline domain. On a budget agent, 78% of observed failures are silent wrong-state failures with no tool error, and the aggregate failure rate is reproducible across disjoint seeds, not sampling noise. We then evaluate a lightweight intervention: deterministic, read-only pre-execution gates that inspect the proposed call and current state before allowing a write. A four-gate suite raises full-benchmark success from 29.6% to 42.0% on gpt-4o-mini (+12.4pp; paired task-level bootstrap P=0.0012), and the lift reproduces on a disjoint 15-seed set (+12.3pp; P=0.0008). The effect is concentrated where the gates fire: on the 26/50 firing tasks, success rises by +19.2pp, while movement on the 24 non-firing tasks does not exclude zero. Two negative controls (a self-enforcing retail domain and BFCL) bound the mechanism: gates help when tools are policy-permissive and add little where tools already self-enforce. As suggestive evidence, not a central claim, the same failure mode persists at the frontier: gpt-5.2 at default reasoning still attempts policy-violating writes, and the same suite improves success from 61.2% to 71.6% (+10.4pp; P=0.020; n=5, no replication). The contribution is a bounded evaluation and reliability result: deterministic gates do not guarantee task success, but they can deterministically prevent a known class of silent policy-violating writes at the action boundary.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究了使用工具的LLM代理在执行任务时可能静默违反策略的失败模式。在策略宽松的环境中，工具可以执行任何格式正确的调用，即使对应的状态转换被域策略禁止。这导致“静默错误状态”（例如，预订被取消、乘客人数被更改、索赔未经验证即被操作），而工具或代理的自我报告均未暴露该问题。作者在τ²-bench航空领域基准中系统研究这一模式：在预算代理上，78%的观察失败是静默错误状态失败（无工具错误），且聚合失败率在不同随机种子间可复现。他们提出了一种轻量级干预措施：确定性的只读预执行门控，在允许写入之前检查提议的调用和当前状态。一个四门控套件将完整基准任务的成功率从29.6%提升至42.0%（gpt-4o-mini，提升12.4个百分点，配对任务级bootstrap P=0.0012），并在另外15个种子集上复现（+12.3pp，P=0.0008）。效果集中在门控触发的任务上：在26个触发任务中，成功率提升19.2个百分点；而24个未触发任务的变化不显著。两个阴性对照（自我执行的零售领域和BFCL）界定了机制：门控在工具策略宽松时有效，在工具已自我执行时收益有限。作为建议性证据而非核心主张，同一失败模式在前沿模型中也存在：gpt-5.2默认推理仍试图进行策略违规写入，相同门控套件将成功率从61.2%提升至71.6%（+10.4pp，P=0.020，n=5，未复现）。论文贡献是一个有边界评估和可靠性结果：确定性门控不能保证任务成功，但可以在动作边界确定性地防止一类已知的静默策略违规写入。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: LLM代理的实际部署中，静默违反策略的失败模式难以被检测，可能导致严重后果。本文提出的确定性门控是一种轻量级、可解释的防御手段，能显著提升策略合规性，对安全工程师构建可靠代理系统具有重要参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接提升工具使用LLM代理在策略合规任务上的成功率，可迁移至航空、零售、金融等需要严格策略约束的自动化场景，也可作为其他防御机制（如RLHF）的补充。
defense_advice_zh: 在工具调用前添加确定性只读预执行门控，检查调用是否违反域策略
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进，在内部代理安全评估中测试类似门控机制

items.title: zk-ScalHard: Scalable and Hardware-Rooted Privacy-Preserving Authentication for Secure OTA Updates in Zonal SDVs
items.summary: The automotive industry is transitioning to Zonal-oriented Architectures (ZoA) for Software-Defined Vehicles (SDVs), enabling frequent over-the-air (OTA) updates for 100+ Electronic Control Units (ECUs). While OTA updates improve efficiency, they introduce safety-critical security risks. Current standards like Uptane and AUTOSAR Adaptive rely on Public-Key Infrastructure (PKI). However, PKI-based authentication creates bandwidth bottlenecks in in-vehicle and vehicle-to-cloud (V2I) communication as ECU density increases. It also risks exposing sensitive vehicle configurations and passenger privacy due to centralized architectures. Next-generation Zonal SDVs require decentralized, scalable authentication with data privacy. To address this, we propose zk-ScalHard, a hardware-rooted, privacy-preserving authentication protocol. We introduce a decentralized, hierarchical trust-promotion model utilizing Silicon Physical Unclonable Functions (PUFs) and two novel Zero-Knowledge Proof (ZKP) circuits: (1) Zonal Identity and Integrity (ZIDI) and (2) High-Performance Computing Aggregation (HPCA). These circuits employ multi-party computation (MPC) and recursive aggregation to achieve decentralization and scalability. The integration of ZKPs and PUFs ensures 100% vehicle-level data sovereignty. Benchmarked against Uptane, zk-ScalHard achieves constant O(1) communication and verification complexity, improving upon the linear O(n) complexity of current systems. Evaluation shows a 99.2% reduction in authentication bandwidth and a 99.9% reduction in the temporal attack surface. Our results demonstrate that zk-ScalHard provides a scalable, secure, and GDPR-compliant architecture for future Zonal SDVs.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种名为zk-ScalHard的硬件根植隐私保护认证协议，旨在解决下一代面向区域的软件定义汽车（SDV）中OTA更新的安全与可扩展性问题。随着汽车电子控制单元（ECU）数量激增，传统的基于公钥基础设施（PKI）的认证方案（如Uptane和AUTOSAR Adaptive）在带宽瓶颈、隐私泄露和中心化架构方面面临挑战。zk-ScalHard通过引入去中心化的层次化信任提升模型，结合硅物理不可克隆函数（PUF）和两种新型零知识证明（ZKP）电路：区域身份与完整性（ZIDI）电路和高性能计算聚合（HPCA）电路，实现了可扩展的隐私保护认证。PUF提供硬件级信任根，确保设备唯一性和防篡改；ZIDI电路验证ECU的身份和软件完整性，HPCA电路通过多方计算（MPC）和递归聚合实现去中心化验证。该协议保证了100%的车辆级数据主权，符合GDPR要求。实验表明，与Uptane相比，zk-ScalHard实现了常数级O(1)的通信和验证复杂度，认证带宽减少99.2%，时间攻击面减少99.9%。该工作为未来区域化SDV提供了可扩展、安全且合规的OTA更新认证框架，适合汽车安全研究人员、系统架构师及标准制定者参考。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究直接针对智能网联汽车OTA更新的核心安全与隐私痛点，提出的硬件与零知识证明结合方案有望取代传统PKI，为解决大规模ECU认证的带宽和隐私问题提供了新思路。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移至车联网V2X通信、分布式IoT设备认证等需要高可扩展性、隐私保护的场景。

items.title: The AI Resilience Gap: Bringing Artificial Intelligence Inside the Operational Resilience Perimeter
items.summary: The rapid adoption of artificial intelligence across regulated firms has produced an extensive governance response oriented around trustworthiness: the EU AI Act, ISO IEC 42001, the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, and the United Kingdom's principles-based approach all address safety, fairness, transparency, and model risk. That response is necessary but incomplete. It does not, on its own, address operational resilience: the continuity of important business services under severe but plausible disruption, the substitutability of AI components, and the concentration of dependency on the small number of firms that supply frontier models. This paper argues that AI adoption creates a resilience obligation that is distinct from, and inadequately covered by, the trustworthy AI stack, and that United Kingdom financial authorities are already closing this gap through the Financial Policy Committee's systemic analysis, the Critical Third Parties regime, and the May 2026 joint statement on frontier AI and cyber resilience. We map the two regulatory logics, identify the structural gap between them, and propose the AI Resilience Framework: a regime-agnostic method for bringing AI dependencies inside the operational resilience perimeter through dependency mapping, a criticality-substitutability tiering, the extension of impact tolerances to AI-specific failure modes, an explicit fallback doctrine, and provider level concentration management. The framework gives chief information security officers, security architects, and boards an actionable route from AI governance policy to demonstrable resilience. This work extends a companion analysis of the United Kingdom cyber resilience regulatory stack into the artificial intelligence dimension.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文指出，受监管机构快速采用人工智能引发了广泛但侧重于可信赖性的治理响应（如欧盟AI法案、ISO/IEC 42001、NIST AI风险管理框架等），但这些措施并未充分解决操作韧性问题——即在严重但合理的干扰下重要业务服务的持续性、AI组件的可替代性以及对少数前沿模型供应商的依赖集中度。作者认为，AI采纳带来了一种与可信赖AI栈不同且未被充分覆盖的韧性义务，并指出英国金融当局已通过金融政策委员会的系统性分析、关键第三方制度以及2026年5月前沿AI与网络韧性联合声明来缩小这一差距。文章映射了两种监管逻辑，识别了它们之间的结构性缺口，并提出了AI韧性框架：一种与具体制度无关的方法，通过依赖映射、关键性-可替代性分层、将影响容忍度扩展到AI特定的故障模式、明确的回退机制以及供应商层面的集中度管理，将AI依赖纳入操作韧性边界。该框架为首席信息安全官、安全架构师和董事会提供了一条从AI治理政策到可证明韧性的可行路径。本文是对英国网络韧性监管栈的补充分析，将其扩展到人工智能维度。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究揭示了现有AI治理框架在操作韧性方面的空白，为安全从业者提供了将AI依赖纳入韧性管理的实用方法，有助于应对AI供应链风险及供应商集中风险。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于受监管行业（如金融、医疗）的安全架构师、CISO及管理层，用于完善AI系统的业务连续性及灾难恢复计划；也可推广至任何依赖第三方AI模型的组织。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进并评估将AI依赖映射和韧性框架纳入内部安全策略的可行性。

items.title: FedCVESA: Taking Away Training Data in Federated Learning via Correlation Value Encoding and Segmented Aggregation
items.summary: Federated learning (FL) avoids explicit data exposure by keeping raw data on local clients, yet privacy risks remain in the training process and the learned model itself. Recently, centralized Taking Away Training Data (TATD) attacks have shown that malicious training could abuse the memorization capacity of deep models to store and later recover training data. However, this memorization-based threat has not been systematically studied under FL environments, where multi-client averaging could overwrite encoded training data. In this paper, we study a white-box TATD attack in which a malicious server selects n target clients from K participating clients and actively writes private training data into the global model during federated training. We propose FedCVESA, a federated variant of Correlation Value Encoding Attack (CVEA), by adding a Pearson-correlation regularizer to the loss function of target clients, so that private training data are gradually encoded into selected model parameters, referred to as carrier parameters. To reduce the overwriting of carrier parameters during server aggregation, we further propose segmented aggregation over dispersed carrier parameters, preserving selected carrier parameters while keeping standard averaging on the remaining parameters. Experiments on MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, and CIFAR-10 under Dirichlet non-IID partitions show that the proposed method can steal semantically meaningful private training images from the trained model while maintaining acceptable main-task utility in a controlled proof-of-concept setting. These results demonstrate that FL can become a parameter-level memorization channel for active TATD attack under the studied white-box malicious-server setting.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 联邦学习（FL）通过将原始数据保留在本地客户端来避免显式数据暴露，但训练过程和模型本身仍存在隐私风险。近期，集中式“取走训练数据”（TATD）攻击表明，恶意训练可利用深度模型的记忆能力存储并恢复训练数据。然而，这种基于记忆的威胁在联邦学习环境下尚未得到系统研究，因为多客户端平均可能覆盖被编码的训练数据。本文研究白盒TATD攻击，恶意服务器从K个参与客户端中选择n个目标客户端，并在联邦训练期间主动将私有训练数据写入全局模型。作者提出FedCVESA，一种基于相关性值编码攻击（CVEA）的联邦变体，通过在目标客户端的损失函数中添加皮尔逊相关性正则化器，使得私有训练数据逐渐编码到选定的模型参数（即载体参数）中。为减少服务器聚合时对载体参数的覆盖，进一步提出对分散的载体参数进行分段聚合：保留选定的载体参数不变，而对剩余参数进行标准平均。在MNIST、Fashion-MNIST和CIFAR-10数据集上，基于Dirichlet非独立同分布划分的实验表明，该方法能从训练模型中窃取具有语义意义的私有训练图像，同时在受控的概念验证设置中保持可接受的主任务效用。这些结果证明，在所研究的白盒恶意服务器设定下，联邦学习可成为主动TATD攻击的参数级记忆通道。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究揭示了联邦学习场景中一种新型主动数据窃取攻击，表明即使不直接访问客户端数据，恶意服务器也能通过参数编码实质上盗取训练数据，对联邦学习的隐私保护构成新威胁。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 联邦学习部署中，如果服务器不可信，则存在训练数据泄露风险；该攻击可泛化到其他基于参数平均的分布式学习场景。

items.title: Safe2Hail: A Forensic-Driven Post-Trip Tracking Framework for Ride-Hailing Safety in Africa
items.summary: Ride-hailing mobile apps have become an essential feature in the mobility ecosystem in Africa, offering much safer and much more affordable rides. Although user bases have increased and the number of daily trips has proliferated, reports of imminent safety threats, particularly after the cancellation of the ride or the ride is prematurely terminated, remain unresolved challenges. Current safety measures offer features such as SOS alerts, safety notifications, and live location sharing for the duration of the trip, but they are not in place when the trip is over. Safe2Hail presents a framework that is forensically driven to ensure continuous safety and certainty beyond the trip. The Safe2Hail framework combines forensic tracking with a temporary post-trip synchronization mechanism that can securely log all proximal data between a passenger and a driver after an event. The Safe2Hail framework was beta-tested and demonstrates the effectiveness of the system. Although the research team did not pilot on actual deployment, the Safe2Hail design format was in part inspired by actual crime events reported in Nairobi and Dar-es-Salaam. The findings of the study referenced Safe2Hail's feasibility, light weight nature of resources, as well as the scalability for the framework.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出 Safe2Hail 框架，针对非洲网约车行业在行程结束后缺乏安全监控的问题。当前大多数网约车应用仅在行程中提供 SOS 警报、安全通知和实时位置共享，但行程取消或提前终止后，乘客和司机便失去安全保障。Safe2Hail 结合数字取证与临时后行程同步机制，在事件发生后安全地记录乘客与司机之间的所有近程数据，从而提供持续的追踪能力。框架设计灵感来源于内罗毕和达累斯萨拉姆的实际犯罪事件，经过 beta 测试验证了其有效性、资源轻量性和可扩展性。论文重点在于提出一种可扩展的、取证驱动的后行程安全解决方案，适用于资源受限的环境。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究填补了网约车安全领域的空白，针对非洲特定场景设计，对提升用户安全信任有实际意义。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移至其他网约车平台或共享出行场景的后行程安全监控。

items.why_it_matters: 该研究填补了网约车安全领域的空白，针对非洲特定场景设计，对提升用户安全信任有实际意义。

items.title: MoLIFE: Methodology, Technologies, and Challenges for Mobile Live Intelligent Forensics Examination
items.summary: Nowadays, mobile forensics is less explored in Digital Forensics case analysis due to the increase in data protection mechanisms implemented by tech companies (i.e., Google for Android and Apple for iOS). For example, the physical acquisition or analysis of specific directories under super-user protection would corrupt the evidence; access to such data is protected, and bypassing this protection requires either privilege escalation or custom ROM installation, leading to the modification of the device state. At the same time, the demand for mobile technologies and their respective communication systems is increasing exponentially, exposing numerous security threats and risks. For that reason, this paper presents a Mobile Live Intelligent Forensics Examination (MoLIFE), a novel Digital Forensics (DF) methodology for data acquisition and analysis of mobile devices. The proposed methodology is based on NIST SP800-101 for the DF process. MoLIFE can be integrated with new and emerging technologies by exploiting their power (e.g., AI, blockchain, quantum computing). MoLIFE can also be used to prevent cyber threats and incidents, as well as DF post-mortem analysis, offering examples of applying the MoLIFE methodology and good practices for the future. To prove the technical feasibility of the methodology, a small case study on Android devices data acquisition via the mDT will be presented. As the methodology is based on new and emerging technologies, it depends on their limitations that would be overcome in a few years.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种名为MoLIFE（Mobile Live Intelligent Forensics Examination）的新型数字取证方法论，用于移动设备的数据获取与分析。随着Android和iOS等移动操作系统不断加强数据保护机制（如超级用户保护下的目录访问限制），传统的物理获取或分析手段可能导致证据损坏，而绕过保护通常需要提权或自定义ROM刷机，会改变设备状态，破坏取证完整性。与此同时，移动技术及其通信系统的需求激增，带来了大量安全威胁。为此，MoLIFE基于NIST SP800-101标准，整合了人工智能、区块链、量子计算等新兴技术，旨在实现实时、智能的移动取证。该方法不仅适用于事后分析，还可用于预防网络威胁和事件响应。论文通过Android设备上的mDT（mobile data tool）数据获取案例研究，验证了方法的技术可行性。MoLIFE提供了一套良好的实践框架，并指出了当前依赖新兴技术所存在的局限性（如性能、成熟度等），但这些局限性预计在未来几年内将被克服。本文适合数字取证研究人员、移动安全工程师及SOC分析师阅读，以了解移动取证的前沿方法论和未来趋势。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 移动设备取证因数据加密和权限保护日益困难，MoLIFE提出了一种可整合AI、区块链等新技术的方法论，为蓝队和安全工程师提供了未来移动取证和事件响应的参考框架。

items.why_it_matters: 移动设备取证因数据加密和权限保护日益困难，MoLIFE提出了一种可整合AI、区块链等新技术的方法论，为蓝队和安全工程师提供了未来移动取证和事件响应的参考框架。

items.title: Monitoring Vulnerabilities in Next-Generation Automotive Operating Systems
items.summary: Software-defined vehicles (SDVs) are revolutionizing transportation by integrating complex, interconnected hardware, and software systems. This evolution introduces significant security challenges. We present a comprehensive security analysis for SDVs, focusing on software vulnerabilities. We note that existing vulnerability assessment tools fall short in addressing operating systems vulnerabilities, particularly when it comes to efficiently analyzing diverse software stacks in realistic environments. We present and release a vulnerability assessment solution that efficiently addresses these limitations. Our approach combines systematic vulnerability discovery, leveraging public Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVE) databases, within a dockerized development environment that evaluates exploitability risks. The results reveal both breadth of potential threats and the practical constraints we faced during exploitation. We discuss the implications for industry and research, and propose directions for building more resilient SDVs.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对下一代软件定义汽车（SDV）中的操作系统安全漏洞进行了全面分析。研究背景是SDV通过集成复杂的硬件和软件系统正在革新交通，但同时也引入了严峻的安全挑战。作者指出现有的漏洞评估工具在处理操作系统漏洞时存在不足，尤其是在真实环境中高效分析多样化软件栈方面。为此，他们提出并发布了一个漏洞评估解决方案，该方案结合了系统化的漏洞发现方法，利用公共的通用漏洞披露（CVE）数据库，并在基于Docker的开发环境中评估漏洞的可利用性风险。实验结果显示，该方法能够揭示潜在威胁的广度，同时也反映了在利用过程中遇到的实际限制。论文最后讨论了这些发现对工业界和学术界的启示，并提出了构建更具韧性的SDV的未来研究方向。该研究的主要贡献在于提供了一个实用的、针对SDV操作系统安全的自动化评估框架，能够帮助安全研究人员和汽车制造商识别关键漏洞并优先修复。对于关注汽车网络安全、嵌入式系统安全以及软件供应链安全的读者具有参考价值。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 随着软件定义汽车成为趋势，操作系统层面的安全漏洞可能直接影响车辆控制和乘客安全。该研究填补了现有漏洞评估工具在汽车OS领域的空白，为蓝队和安全工程师提供了自动化检测方案。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可应用于智能汽车、自动驾驶系统、车联网等场景的操作系统安全评估。

items.title: Finding and Understanding Miscompilation Bugs in the Solidity Compiler
items.summary: Smart contract compilers are critical to ensuring the correctness of public blockchains whose defining characteristics are open-source and immutable code. We created SolSmith, a semantics-aware differential fuzz testing tool, to improve the quality of the Solidity compiler -- the most popular compiler for the Ethereum blockchain -- and spent over three years finding compiler defects that produce incorrect code. We call these defects miscompilation bugs. During this time period, we have discovered 25 miscompilation bugs that went unnoticed, some for multiple years. Our first contribution is to make compiler testing more rigorous. SolSmith achieves this goal by generating valid test programs that are likely to stress test code generation and optimization components. This helps SolSmith find bugs missed during routine testing that could potentially have serious implications for smart contracts and their users. Our second contribution is a qualitative and quantitative analysis of miscompilation bugs that we found in the Solidity compiler. We classify miscompilation bugs found by SolSmith based on their nature, root-causes, and impact on end-users. This sheds light on some pitfalls of optimizing compilers.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对Solidity编译器中存在的误编译（miscompilation）漏洞进行了系统的发现与分析。Solidity是以太坊区块链上最流行的智能合约语言，其编译器的正确性直接关系到链上代码的不可篡改性和安全性。作者设计并实现了SolSmith——一个基于语义感知的差异模糊测试工具，用于自动化检测Solidity编译器在代码生成和优化阶段产生的错误。SolSmith通过生成语义等价但语法多变的测试程序，有效触发了编译器内部路径，从而揭露了常规测试难以发现的缺陷。在超过三年的持续测试中，SolSmith共发现25个此前未知的误编译bug，部分bug已存在多年。论文的贡献包括：1）提出了更严格的编译器测试方法，通过语义等价变异和增量式测试生成，提高了对代码生成和优化组件的压力测试能力；2）对这些误编译bug进行了定性和定量分析，按性质、根本原因和对最终用户的影响进行了分类，揭示了优化编译器的一些常见陷阱。分析表明，这些bug可能导致生成的字节码与源代码语义不一致，进而引发智能合约逻辑错误、资产损失或安全漏洞。本文适合编译器开发者、区块链安全研究员以及智能合约审计人员阅读，以了解Solidity编译器的潜在风险和改进方向。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 智能合约编译器是区块链安全的关键基础设施，任何误编译bug都可能导致严重的经济损失。本文首次系统性地揭示了Solidity编译器的长期隐藏缺陷，为提升编译器可靠性提供了方法论和实证。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接影响所有使用Solidity编译器的智能合约开发者；发现的25个bug可能影响历史合约的正确性；方法论可迁移至其他区块链编译器（如Vyper）的检测。

items.why_it_matters: 智能合约编译器是区块链安全的关键基础设施，任何误编译bug都可能导致严重的经济损失。本文首次系统性地揭示了Solidity编译器的长期隐藏缺陷，为提升编译器可靠性提供了方法论和实证。

items.title: Continual Learning With Participation Privacy: An Auditable Buffering-Aggregation Recipe
items.summary: Modern federated and streaming learning systems often release intermediate models, so privacy must hold for the full trajectory under adaptive interaction. Motivated by participation privacy, we study single-edit neighboring user streams, where one insertion/deletion shifts all subsequent updates and defeats standard Hamming-neighbor continual-release analyses. We give an auditable modular recipe. A randomized buffering wrapper emits bins of size $[U,2U]$, reducing single-edit streams to a Hamming-style per-bin update stream with explicit backlog/delay guarantees, where $U$ is calibrated by the privacy parameters $(\varepsilon,δ)$. We then prove a certification theorem identifying when a non-adaptive Hamming-neighbor DP proof for a continual primitive lifts to adaptive inputs: the primitive must use fresh per-round randomness and have a stable one-round privacy profile under common adaptive context. Together, these ingredients yield trajectory-level $(\varepsilon,δ)$-DP for single-edit streams using standard primitives (e.g., tree prefix sums), with an explicit privacy--latency link via $U$.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究持续学习场景下的参与隐私（Participation Privacy）问题。在联邦学习、流式学习中，模型往往持续更新并发布中间模型，因此隐私保护需覆盖完整轨迹并适应自适应交互。针对单次编辑的相邻用户流（即一个插入或删除操作会导致后续所有更新偏移），传统的汉明相邻持续发布分析无法直接适用。为此，作者提出了一种可审计的模块化方案：首先，设计一个随机缓冲包装器，将输入流以随机化方式分桶，每个桶大小介于[U,2U]之间，从而将单次编辑流转化为每个桶上的汉明风格更新流，并给出明确的回压/延迟保证。参数U由隐私参数(ε,δ)校准。其次，证明了一个认证定理，指出当非自适应汉明相邻差分隐私证明满足以下条件时可提升至自适应输入：原语必须每轮使用新鲜随机性，且在通用自适应上下文下具有稳定的单轮隐私分布。结合这两部分，利用标准的树前缀和等原语，即可为单次编辑流提供轨迹级别的(ε,δ)-差分隐私保护，并建立了通过U参数化的隐私-延迟权衡。本文为持续学习中的用户参与隐私提供了理论框架和实用构造，适合对差分隐私、联邦学习、流式学习理论感兴趣的研究人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 参与隐私是现代联邦/流式学习中的关键痛点，本文首次在单次编辑流下给出了可审计的模块化解法，填补了理论空白，对隐私保护机器学习具有重要指导意义。

items.title: Evaluating Endpoint Detection Robustness Against Genetic Algorithm Driven Code Transformations
items.summary: Post-compromise test variants are widely used in controlled security evaluation and endpoint robustness benchmarking. However, modern Antivirus (AV) and Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) systems increasingly combine signature- and behavior-based detection, challenging the reliability of conventional detection pipelines under adaptive variation. This study introduces ShellForge, a Genetic Algorithm (GA)-driven framework that evolves post-compromise variants representative of remote command execution to generate functionally equivalent variants for systematic detection evaluation. ShellForge applies syntactic transformations, encoding schemes, and structural permutations guided by a multi-objective fitness function informed by AV and EDR detection feedback. We compare ShellForge against representative baseline transformation frameworks under identical sandbox configurations. Our findings highlight measurable robustness gaps in baseline signature- and behavior-oriented detection pipelines under controlled variant generation. In addition, we propose a reproducible benchmark for endpoint detection robustness evaluation, motivating the need for robustness-aware defensive monitoring and behavioral correlation.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出了一种名为 ShellForge 的遗传算法驱动框架，用于生成后渗透测试变种，以系统评估端点检测系统（AV/EDR）的鲁棒性。当前 AV 和 EDR 系统结合了签名和基于行为的检测，但在面对适应性变种时可靠性不足。ShellForge 以远程命令执行的后渗透变种为基线，通过遗传算法应用句法变换、编码方案和结构置换，利用多目标适应度函数（结合 AV/EDR 检测反馈）指导进化，生成功能等价但形态不同的变种。在相同沙箱配置下，对比了若干基线变换框架，实验揭示了现有签名和基于行为的检测流水线在受控变种生成下的显著鲁棒性差距。论文还提出了一种可复现的端点检测鲁棒性基准测试方法，为防御监控和行为关联的鲁棒性感知提供了必要性。该研究主要贡献在于：1) 提出了 GA 驱动框架自动生成检测逃逸变种；2) 量化了主流 EDR 产品的检测盲区；3) 建立了标准化的鲁棒性评估基准。适合安全防御研究人员、EDR 开发者和渗透测试人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 揭示了当前端点检测系统在面对自动化变种生成时的脆弱性，为EDR/AV厂商改进检测算法和防御团队设计鲁棒性监控策略提供了可复现的评估方法。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接影响端点安全产品的有效性评估；可迁移到任何依赖签名或行为检测的安全工具鲁棒性测试场景。

items.title: Certifying Ghosts: How Cybersecurity AI Agents Break the EU Cyber Resilience Act
items.summary: The EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA) makes a smart bet. It does not demand that products be free of vulnerabilities, but only that manufacturers run a process: assess risk, handle flaws, ship updates. The bet pays off if four things about the world stay true: (P1) finding vulnerabilities is slow, skilled, human work; (P2) a product's exploitable flaws are knowable the day it ships; (P3) exploitation is rare enough to notice; and (P4) fixes keep pace with discovery. Cybersecurity AI (CAI) agents, AI put to work finding and exploiting flaws in other products, falsify all four. The regime answers in two opposite ways. Against the sheer volume of flaws that agents surface it bends (P1): built for scarce attention, it re-centres compliance on defensible, documented prioritisation, and holds. But agents also collapse the speed and economics of the vulnerability lifecycle, and here it breaks (P2, P3, P4): a product that passed every check becomes exploitable without anyone touching it, so its market-entry test, its reporting trigger, and its one-and-done certificate vouch for a security that has quietly expired. The fault is in the landscape, not the product, so running the process more diligently cannot repair it. We map each mechanism to the force that strains or snaps it, and find the cure and the disease cut from the same cloth: because defenders and attackers wield the same AI, the only conformity that survives is one that never stops running. We also carry the remedy from proposal to proof on two CRA-scope robots, a humanoid and a lawn mower, where an agentic defender holds a line their undefended selves cannot. On the evidence already in hand, the CRA reaches full force in December 2027 certifying products against a world that has already changed. Static, human-paced security is finished; what replaces it must be continuous and agent-operated, and that is no longer a matter of taste.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文分析了欧盟《网络弹性法案》（CRA）在面对网络安全AI代理（CAI代理）时的局限性。CRA的核心逻辑是要求制造商运行一个流程（风险评估、漏洞处理、更新发布），而非保证产品绝对无漏洞。该逻辑依赖于四项假设：（P1）发现漏洞是缓慢、需要熟练人工的工作；（P2）产品在出厂时的可利用漏洞是已知的；（P3）漏洞利用足够罕见以至于能够被注意到；（P4）修复速度与发现速度保持同步。然而，CAI代理能够自动寻找并利用其他产品中的漏洞，从而彻底颠覆了上述假设。面对CAI代理带来的海量漏洞，CRA在P1上通过将合规重点转向可辩护的、有文档记录的优先级排序得以勉强维持；但在漏洞生命周期的速度和经济学上（P2、P3、P4），CRA被彻底击穿：一个通过所有检查的产品，可能在无人修改的情况下变得可被利用，其市场准入测试、报告触发点和一次性认证证书所担保的安全性早已悄然失效。问题的根源在于环境变化而非产品本身，因此更勤奋地执行流程也无法修复。作者将每个机制映射到使其紧张或断裂的力量，并指出防御者和攻击者使用相同的AI，因此唯一能够存续的合规形式是永不停止的持续验证。作者还在两个CRA范围内的机器人（一个类人机器人和一个割草机）上将这一补救措施从提议推进到证明，展示了防御代理能够守住未防御者无法守住的防线。结论表明，静态、人工节奏的安全性已经结束，取而代之的必须是持续且由代理操作的安全，而这已不再是品味问题。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 本文揭示了即将于2027年12月全面生效的欧盟CRA框架在AI代理威胁下的根本缺陷，迫使安全从业者重新思考合规策略和产品安全生命周期模型。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响物联网、机器人、消费电子产品等受CRA监管的行业；可能推动认证机构采纳持续安全验证机制。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 关注相关研究进展，评估自身产品对AI代理攻击的防御能力，并探索持续安全验证的可行性。

items.title: Operational Reframing and Approval-Framed Delegation in Multi-Agent LLM Safety
items.summary: Safety evaluations of multi-agent LLM systems often compare a direct prompt with a planner-executor pipeline and report the difference as a single "pipeline effect." We argue that this aggregate is difficult to interpret because it conflates three mechanisms: harmful intent may be reframed as plausible operational work, the planner may refuse or transform the request, and the executor may act under delegation prompts implying prior approval. To separate these factors, we introduce a five-condition controlled contrast design, evaluated on 30 synthetic harmful scenarios and an exploratory external validation set from four agent-safety benchmarks using LLM-judged compliance. Our results show that aggregate pipeline safety is not a stable architectural property. Operational reframing is the most portable risk signal, increasing compliance for GPT, Gemini, and DeepSeek across both scenario sets, while Claude is comparatively resistant. Planner behavior can offset this risk mainly through refusal; however, when the planner produces executable steps, the executor may become more compliant than under the direct operational baseline. Approval-framed delegation is sensitive to prompt design, model pairing, and scenario source, and a skeptical executor prompt sharply reduces compliance. Raw-direct model rankings can also mispredict deployed planner-executor behavior. Gemini is safest under raw direct prompts in the primary set yet shows the largest amplification with a Claude planner, rising from 8.9 percent to 38.9 percent compliance. GPTs near-zero aggregate pipeline effect instead hides a reframing increase canceled by planner refusal. These findings suggest that multi-agent safety evaluations should report reframing, planner behavior, delegation framing, and model pairing separately before attributing failures to architecture itself.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对多智能体大语言模型（LLM）系统的安全评估问题，指出传统方法将直接提示与规划-执行流水线进行对比，得到的单一“流水线效应”难以解释，因为它混叠了三种不同机制：有害意图被重新构建为合理的操作工作（operational reframing）、规划者拒绝或转换请求、以及执行者在暗示预先批准的委托提示下行动。为分离这些因素，作者提出一种五条件受控对比设计，在30个合成有害场景及来自四个智能体安全基准的探索性外部验证集上，使用LLM评判合规性进行评估。结果表明，聚合的流水线安全性并非稳定的架构属性。操作重构是最具可移植性的风险信号，能增加GPT、Gemini和DeepSeek的合规性，而Claude相对抵抗。规划者主要通过拒绝来抵消风险；但当规划者生成可执行步骤时，执行者的合规性可能高于直接操作基线。带批准框架的委托对提示设计、模型配对和场景来源敏感，而怀疑性的执行者提示可显著降低合规性。直接提示的模型排名无法预测部署的规划-执行行为：Gemini在直接提示下最安全，但与Claude规划者配对时合规性从8.9%升至38.9%；GPT近乎为零的聚合流水线效应实际上隐藏了由规划者拒绝抵消的重构增加。这些发现表明，多智能体安全评估应在将失败归因于架构本身之前，分别报告重构、规划者行为、委托框架和模型配对的影响。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究揭示了多智能体LLM安全评估中聚合指标的误导性，为安全从业者提供了更细粒度的分析框架，有助于理解不同模型组合下的真实风险来源。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 对多智能体LLM系统的安全测评方法论有直接影响，尤其适用于评估规划-执行架构中的安全漏洞。

items.title: Is Randomness Necessary for Adaptive Data Analysis?
items.summary: The Adaptive Data Analysis (ADA) problem formalizes the challenge of preventing false discovery and overfitting when a dataset is repeatedly reused. Formally, our input is a dataset containing $n$ i.i.d. samples from an unknown distribution $\mathcal{P}$ over a domain $\mathcal{X}$, and our goal is to answer a sequence of $k$ adaptively chosen statistical queries with respect to $\mathcal{P}$. The main question is how many queries we can support (i.e., how large $k$ can be), primarily as a function of the number of samples $n$. This question has been intensively studied and is relatively well-understood for randomized mechanisms: there are computationally efficient mechanisms that support $k \approx n^2$ queries, and no computationally efficient mechanism can answer $k \gg n^2$ queries. In this paper, we address a fundamental question: is randomness necessary for ADA? Despite a decade of work on ADA, this question remains open. A folklore observation dating back to the initial works on ADA is that randomness is not necessary when the analyst is computationally bounded. Yet, the necessity of randomness against computationally unbounded analysts has remained elusive. Our main contribution resolves this gap in the information-theoretic Random Oracle model. Perhaps surprisingly, we show that randomness is strictly necessary to answer a non-trivial number of adaptive queries: when the analyst is unbounded, any deterministic mechanism can be forced to fail after just $k = \tilde{O} (n)$ queries.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 自适应数据分析（ADA）问题旨在形式化描述当数据集被重复使用时如何防止假发现和过拟合。输入是一个包含 n 个独立同分布样本的数据集，这些样本来自未知分布 P，目标是回答一系列自适应选择的统计查询。已有研究表明，对于随机化机制，存在计算高效的机制可支持约 n^2 个查询，且任何计算高效机制都无法支持远超 n^2 个查询。然而，随机性是否是 ADA 的必要条件这一问题，尽管经过十年研究仍未解决。一个早期观察是，当分析师计算能力受限时，随机性并非必需；但对于无计算限制的分析师，随机性的必要性一直未知。本文在信息论随机预言机模型下解决了这一空白。令人惊讶的是，作者证明当分析师无计算限制时，任何确定性机制在约 O(n) 个查询后必然失败，而随机化机制可支持 Ω(n^2) 个查询。这表明随机性是回答非平凡数量自适应查询的严格必要条件。该结果回答了 ADA 领域的一个根本性问题，并为确定性机制的能力设立了严格界限。适合理论计算机科学和统计学方向的研究者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究解决了自适应数据分析中随机性必要性的长期开放问题，揭示了确定性机制在无限制分析师下的根本局限性，对理解数据重用的统计理论有重要意义。

items.title: Cyber Dynamics I: Finite Macrostates for Behavioral Anomaly Detection in Network Telemetry
items.summary: Entropy-based methods have long been used for network anomaly detection, but most existing approaches treat entropy as a scalar statistic on narrow observables rather than as part of a broader behavioral state-space for cyber systems. We propose a finite-dimensional macrostate framework for network telemetry, instantiated over the Canonical Security Telemetry Substrate (CSTS), so that coarse-graining is performed over persistent entities, typed relations, and temporal state rather than isolated event records. The resulting macrostate captures activity, distributional disorder, structural organization, temporal volatility, persistence, and deviation from benign baselines. Rather than scoring only unusual states, we model window-to-window macrostate transitions and define regime structure, stability, and anomalous change. This supports discrimination between benign workload drift and adversarial reorganization. We evaluate the framework on benchmark network telemetry datasets and compare it against Shannon-, Rényi-, and Tsallis-style entropy baselines, as well as standard anomaly detectors. The proposed representation improves anomaly discrimination and supports more interpretable behavioral analysis of cyber telemetry.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出了一种基于有限维度宏状态（finite macrostates）的网络异常检测框架，用于分析网络遥测数据中的行为异常。传统基于熵的方法通常将熵视为窄观测上的标量统计量，而忽略了网络系统的整体行为状态空间。作者在规范安全遥测基板（CSTS）上实例化该框架，对持久实体、类型化关系和时序状态进行粗粒化处理，而不是孤立的事件记录。生成的宏状态捕获活动性、分布无序性、结构组织、时序波动性、持久性以及与良性基线的偏差。论文进一步建模窗口间宏状态转换，定义状态结构、稳定性和异常变化，从而区分良性工作负载漂移和对抗性重组。在基准网络遥测数据集上的评估表明，该表示方法在异常区分度上优于Shannon、Rényi和Tsallis熵基线以及标准异常检测器，并支持更可解释的遥测行为分析。核心贡献包括：提出宏状态框架、定义状态转换分析、以及通过实验证明其有效性。适合研究网络异常检测、行为分析和安全遥测的数据科学家和安全工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 本文提出了一种超越传统熵统计的宏状态异常检测方法，为网络行为分析提供了更可解释和鲁棒的框架，有助于区分正常负载变化和恶意行为，对蓝队提升网络威胁检测能力具有参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可应用于企业网络遥测分析、入侵检测系统（IDS）、安全运营中心（SOC）的异常行为识别，以及大规模网络环境下的审计数据挖掘。

items.title: Deanonymizing Monero Transactions in Tor Network
items.summary: Monero is a privacy-focused cryptocurrency that deploys the Dandelion++ protocol and incorporates anonymity networks (such as Tor and I2P) to prevent malicious attackers from linking transactions with their source IPs. In this paper, we demonstrate that Monero's integration of the Tor network introduces a fundamental vulnerability: a Monero Tor node's originated transactions are exclusively forwarded to two outgoing Tor hidden service nodes (proxy nodes) prior to clearnet propagation, enabling an adversary to capture originated transactions by occupying the target node's outgoing connections. Based on this observation, we propose \textit{ProxyMark}, a three-stage deanonymization framework for the Monero Tor network, comprising node role identification, originated transaction identification, and node location deanonymization. Through experiments on the live Tor network, Monero mainnet, and testnet, we empirically demonstrate the effectiveness of \textit{ProxyMark} in successfully deanonymizing transactions originating from Monero nodes over Tor.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对以隐私保护为目标的加密货币 Monero 在集成 Tor 网络时引入的潜在漏洞进行了系统性研究。Monero 采用 Dandelion++ 协议并结合 Tor、I2P 等匿名网络，旨在防止攻击者将交易与源 IP 地址关联。然而，作者发现 Monero Tor 节点发出的交易在进入明网传播之前，会先被转发至两个指定的 Tor 隐藏服务节点（代理节点），这一设计存在根本性缺陷：攻击者可以通过占据目标节点的传出连接来捕获这些原始交易。基于此观察，作者提出了名为 ProxyMark 的三阶段去匿名化框架，包括节点角色识别、原始交易识别和节点位置去匿名化。通过在真实 Tor 网络、Monero 主网和测试网上进行实验，ProxyMark 成功地对通过 Tor 发出的 Monero 交易进行了去匿名化，证明了该漏洞的可利用性。该研究揭示了一个重要的安全警示：即使采用匿名网络，系统集成中的细微设计缺陷仍可能导致隐私崩溃。本文适合加密货币安全研究人员、Monero 开发者以及关注网络隐私的学者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: Monero 曾被视为最强隐私币，但本文揭示其 Tor 集成存在致命缺陷，攻击者可低成本关联交易与节点 IP，动摇用户对 Monero 匿名性的信任。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接威胁 Monero 用户的隐私，该方法可能推广至其他依赖 Tor 的匿名系统或加密货币。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进：评估该漏洞对自有 Monero 节点的影响，关注官方修复进展。

items.title: An Automated Framework for Generating Stealthy Cell-Embedded Hardware Trojans
items.summary: Hardware Trojans (HTs) pose significant threats across the Integrated Circuit (IC) design lifecycle because they can be inserted by untrusted entities at different stages under the zero-trust model. When triggered under rare conditions, HTs can compromise the functionality, reliability, or security of the fabricated chip. HT assessment is typically performed by modeling realistic Trojan insertion scenarios in RTL implementation or gate-level netlists. While this model is useful for evaluating detection methods, it does not capture attacks where malicious behavior is hidden inside standard-cell implementations from a compromised library supplied by an untrusted vendor. This paper presents a novel framework for automatically generating cell-embedded hardware Trojans using compromised standard-cell implementations. Our proposed framework analyzes a mapped design, identifies candidate cell instances with rare input conditions, and applies payload templates that corrupt the selected cell output only when the trigger condition is satisfied. Experiments on open-source combinational and sequential benchmark designs show that our proposed framework can generate valid and stealthy Trojan instances across different cell types and design sizes. The results highlight a critical gap in current Trojan detection assumptions and show the need for cell-aware validation of standard-cell implementations in zero-trust IC design flows.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 硬件木马（HT）在集成电路（IC）设计生命周期中构成重大威胁，因为不可信实体在零信任模型下可以在不同阶段插入HT。当在罕见条件下触发时，HT会损害芯片的功能、可靠性或安全性。传统的HT评估通常通过在RTL实现或门级网表中模拟真实的木马插入场景进行，但这种方法无法捕捉恶意行为隐藏在来自不可信供应商的受损标准单元库中的攻击。本文提出了一种新颖的框架，用于利用受损的标准单元实现自动生成单元嵌入的硬件木马。该框架分析映射后的设计，识别具有稀有输入条件的候选单元实例，并应用有效载荷模板，仅在触发条件满足时破坏选定单元的输出。在开源组合和时序基准设计上的实验表明，该框架能够在不同单元类型和设计规模下生成有效且隐秘的木马实例。结果凸显了当前木马检测假设中的关键空白，并表明在零信任IC设计流程中需要对标准单元实现进行单元感知验证。该研究对于硬件安全研究人员、IC设计验证工程师以及关注零信任供应链安全的从业者具有参考价值。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 暴露了现有硬件木马检测方法的一个盲区：恶意行为可隐藏于标准单元库内部，而非仅在RTL或门级。推动IC设计流程采用单元感知验证，对零信任供应链安全有重要意义。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接影响IC设计工具和第三方IP核的信任验证流程，可能威胁到国防、金融等关键领域芯片的安全性。

items.title: Thinking More, Harnessing Better: State Machine Guided Harness Automatic Generation with Project Digestion and Workflow Decomposition
items.summary: High-quality fuzz harnesses are essential for effective gray-box fuzzing. While Large Language Models (LLMs) offer promise for automating this task, existing one-turn generation methods suffer from hallucinations and inadequate coverage due to coarse-grained function targeting and misaligned generation workflows. We present SynapseFlow, an automatic harness generator that addresses these limitations through two key innovations: dataflow-aware function aggregation and a staged, rollback-enabled generation workflow decomposition. SynapseFlow first analyzes source code to construct Structural Flow Graphs and extract coherent Function Triplets. It then synthesizes harnesses via a decomposed four-stage process governed by a staged rollback algorithm to ensure correctness. We evaluated SynapseFlow on 25 real-world open-source software projects. The experimental results indicate that SynapseFlow outperforms state-of-the-art tools (OSS-Fuzz-Gen, CKGFuzzer, PromeFuzz), achieving 3.07$\times$, 1.71$\times$, and 4.26$\times$ higher branch coverage, and 1.77$\times$, 1.51$\times$, and 1.36$\times$ higher bug detection rates, respectively. Most importantly, SynapseFlow discovered 7 previously unreported bugs (5 assigned CVEs), demonstrating its practical effectiveness in real-world bug discovery.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 高质量的fuzz harness是进行有效灰盒测试的关键，但手动编写harness耗时且容易出错。现有基于大语言模型（LLM）的自动生成方法存在因粗粒度的函数定位和不匹配的生成工作流导致的幻觉和覆盖率不足问题。本文提出SynapseFlow，一种自动harness生成器，通过两项核心创新解决上述局限：数据流感知的函数聚合和分阶段、支持回滚的生成工作流分解。SynapseFlow首先分析源代码以构建结构流图（Structural Flow Graphs）并提取连贯的函数三元组（Function Triplets）。然后，它通过一个分阶段的四阶段流程合成harness，并由一个分阶段回滚算法确保生成正确性。实验在25个真实世界开源软件项目上进行，结果表明SynapseFlow在分支覆盖率上比现有最先进工具（OSS-Fuzz-Gen、CKGFuzzer、PromeFuzz）分别高出3.07倍、1.71倍和4.26倍，在bug检测率上分别高出1.77倍、1.51倍和1.36倍。更重要的是，SynapseFlow发现了7个此前未报告的漏洞（其中5个已分配CVE编号），展示了其在实际漏洞发现中的有效性。该研究对于提升模糊测试的自动化程度和实际效果具有重要价值，适合安全研究者和工具开发者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 模糊测试是漏洞发现的核心技术，但harness编写是主要瓶颈。SynapseFlow利用LLM和代码分析自动化生成高质量harness，显著提升覆盖率与漏洞发现效率，有望推动自动化安全测试的实用化。
